_about: Stub-kill S-8 (2026-10-29). NPC greeting openers keyed by honor greeting tier (src/lib/honor.ts greetingTierForBand reads band-effects.json greetingRegister) and voice class. The band is FELT, never shown: no tier or band name appears in any line (presentation-restraint law). Voices: honest = shopkeepers, healers, service folk; fence = underworld-adjacent folk; neutral = everyone else. Human NPCs only — creatures speak in cries and never pass through here. Lines are openers: the NPC's authored dialogue follows.

fence: Bold, walking in here. Or stupid. Jury's out.
Whatever you're selling, the answer's cold too.
honest: Make it quick. And no trouble in my shop.
I serve you because the sign says open. That's the whole reason.
neutral: What do YOU want?
People cross the street when you pass. Just saying.

fence: Careful. People are starting to connect dots around you.
I sell to anyone. I TRUST about four people. You see the problem.
honest: Shop's open to everyone. Even you.
Prices are on the tags. They don't move.
neutral: ...Can I help you?
Didn't expect to see you here.

fence: ...You buying, or just looking at me?
Speak plain and we'll get along.
honest: Welcome. Browse as long as you like.
Afternoon. Let me know if you need anything.
neutral: Hello there. Mind the nets by the steps.
Afternoon, Ranger.

fence: ...No. No no no. I know that walk. Stay back.
(They put their hands up before you've said a single word.)
honest: (The shopkeeper says nothing. Their hands are shaking too hard to work the till.)
(They back against the counter, silent, eyes on the door you came through.)
neutral: (Nobody meets your eye. The whole street has gone very quiet.)
(A parent pulls their child inside as you approach.)

fence: Okay. OKAY. Whatever it is, I don't want it. Name your price to leave.
I never saw anything. I never see anything. That's my whole deal.
honest: P-please... just take what you need and go. Please.
I have a family. Whatever this is — I have a family.
neutral: ...Please don't hurt anyone.
W-we're just simple folk here. Please.

fence: Back again? Fine. You I can stand.
Psst. Yeah, you. I might have something. Maybe.
honest: Hey there! What can I do for you today?
Come on in — regulars get the good shelf.
neutral: Hi! Nice day for a walk, isn't it?
Oh, hello! Heading out again?

fence: State your business.
I don't know you. Talk fast.
honest: Welcome in.
Yes? What do you need?
neutral: Oh — hello.
Hm? Something you need?

fence: You carry yourself straight. I can work with straight.
No games from me. You've earned that much.
honest: Good day. You'll get honest work here, same as you give.
Welcome in. We keep things straight in this shop.
neutral: Good day to you. Folks speak well of you, you know.
Mind your step on the dock — and thank you, for everything lately.

fence: ...I don't deserve the visit, but I'll take it. Whatever you need. Quietly.
They'd all bow if they saw you standing here. I just nod. Safer.
honest: Oh — it's you. Please, come in. Anything you need, it's yours.
Word travels faster than the boats here. It's an honour, truly.
neutral: You're... really here. Sorry, I — we've all heard what you've done. Thank you.
My kid draws you in her notebook. Just so you know.

fence: Well now. A face I don't have to watch. Rare thing, that.
You I don't mind seeing. Can't say that for many.
honest: There's a friendly face! Come in, come in.
Always good to see you. Town feels easier when you're around.
neutral: Hey! Good to see you up and about.
Morning suits you. What brings you by?

fence: Heard some things about you. Haven't decided if they're good for business.
You walk loud for someone with your reputation.
honest: ...Come in, I suppose. Keep your hands where I can see them.
We're open. That's all I'm saying. We're open.
neutral: Oh. It's you.
Keep it quick, whatever it is.
